visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black hoodie, a black baseball cap, and blue and yellow sneakers is standing on a green synthetic grass mat at an outdoor driving range. To his right, a woman with long dark hair, wearing a very low-cut tan-colored long-sleeve top and black leggings, stands close to him, touching his left arm as if instructing his golf swing. The background shows the driving range field illuminated by artificial lights at night. (2) A second woman wearing a white long-sleeve sweater and a short grey pleated skirt joins the scene, kneeling on the green mat directly in front of the man's legs. The man keeps his eyes on the golf ball, holding the club in a prepared stance, while the first woman remains by his side. The environment remains dark with bright green turf and white barriers. (3) A third woman appears on the man's left, wearing a grey beanie and a deeply plunging black and white top. She crouches low to the ground. The man is now surrounded by three women in various coaching positions, creating a crowded and humorous scene. He remains in his golf stance, staring downward, as the text indicates the highest coaching price.
